correctness.rationale: The full spine-colour transfer for caterpillar pendant counts (2,r,r-1,r+1) and (2,r+1,r-1,r) yields an identity for their difference by pairing the second and fourth spine colours. For palette size 3 the (0,2) contribution vanishes and the remaining two cancel exactly for all r and all q. The two trees have common bipartition sizes (r+3,2r+3), making their two-colour terms identical; since connected 3-colour proper colourings use either two or three colours, equality extends to the entire t-refined third specialization. For palette size 4, the [q^8] coefficient generating function in r is exactly -14z-4z²-2z³/(1-z), independently rederived using q-adic rational-series recurrences, so coefficients -14,-4,-2 separate all r. Their four-part canonical spine vectors are not reversals; finite checks do not replace the all-r identities.
